name: SHUBHAM
intro: I build machine-learning projects from raw data to a deployed app, and I check my own results hard: baselines first, cross-validation, and being clear about what the data can and cannot show. Mathematics & Computing at Delhi Technological University.

projects.name: Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
projects.description: End-to-end pipeline on 900K+ sales records. LightGBM beats a seasonal-naive baseline, and a safety-stock policy plus a business simulation turn the forecasts into inventory decisions.

projects.name: India House Price Predictor
projects.description: Gradient-boosting price estimator for Indian cities, trained on synthetic data calibrated to 2026 asking-price benchmarks. The original pipeline compares five models with cross-validation.

projects.name: Meshdoot
projects.description: Offline Bluetooth mesh that passes prioritised, location-tagged SOS messages from phone to phone when the network is down. Critical messages get relayed first.
projects.note: SEVA FIRST Innovation Challenge 2026, with Tanush

projects.name: Chaukanna
projects.description: On-device scam message and link checker for Hindi and English. It explains why a message looks risky, and nothing leaves the phone.
projects.note: SEVA FIRST Innovation Challenge 2026, with Tanush
